meta.name: offer-claims-registry
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "register this claim", "log our current offers", or "where is the proof for this figure"; curates the canonical claims ledger and live-offers table under memory/claims/ — exact claim text, evidence provenance, approved wording, claim-level disclaimers, and offer terms — and resolves "[needs source]" flags from ad and content drafts. Not for scoring O1/O2 vetoes or issuing SHIP/FIX/BLOCK verdicts — use ad-account-auditor; not for gating creator content — use content-reviewer. 广告声明台账/优惠信息登记/证据溯源

copy.tagline: 登记广告声明与优惠信息，并溯源证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理广告声明台账和优惠信息登记
copy.tagline_en: Register ad claims and offers with evidence provenance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage an ad claims ledger and offer terms

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会管理一个营销声明和优惠信息的台账。它能记录每条声明的原文、证据来源、批准措辞和免责声明，还能更新优惠表，并解决广告草稿中标记为“[needs source]”的问题。
howto.when: 当你要求“注册这个声明”、“记录我们当前的优惠”或“这个数字的证据在哪里”时触发。也适用于更新或过期声明、解决广告草稿中的来源缺失标记。

say.text: 注册这个声明：“我们的产品销量第一”——证据是2024年市场报告。
say.note: Claude 会在台账中新增一行，记录声明原文和证据。

say.text: 记录我们当前的优惠：满200减50，代码SAVE50，有效期至月底。
say.note: Claude 会更新优惠表，包含条款、代码和日期。

say.text: 扫描候选文件，解决广告草稿中的[needs source]标记。
say.note: Claude 会检查候选声明并补充证据来源。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude manages a ledger of marketing claims and offers. It records exact claim text, evidence provenance, approved wording, and disclaimers, updates the offers table, and resolves "[needs source]" flags from ad drafts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "register this claim", "log our current offers", or "where is the proof for this figure". Also for updating or expiring claims, or resolving missing source flags in ad drafts.

say_en.text: Register this claim: "Our product is #1" — evidence: 2024 market report.
say_en.note: Claude adds a row with claim text and evidence.

say_en.text: Log our current offers: spend $200 save $50, code SAVE50, valid until month end.
say_en.note: Claude updates the offers table with terms, code, and dates.

say_en.text: Sweep candidates file and resolve [needs source] flags from ad drafts.
say_en.note: Claude checks candidate claims and adds evidence sources.
